title: Azzanadra's Quest
start: Talk to Azzanadra at the Council of Burthorpe upstairs in the Burthorpe Castle.

recommended.t: Blank observation (if the quest Heart of Stone has been completed. Given to the player during the quest if not already owned)
Wicked hood or Traveller's necklace (for the Wizards' Tower teleport)

The Heart teleport (for quick access to the Heart of Gielinor, requires Tales of the God Wars miniquest; alternatively, one can use a desert amulet 2, 3, or 4 to teleport to Nardah and run south-west from there)

Sixth-Age circuit for quick access to the World Gate; alternatively, teleport to the Eagles' Peak lodestone and run south; use five metallic dragon trinkets (rune dragon teleport, consumed); or use traveller's necklace to teleport to the Outpost and run west
Master archaeologist's outfit (for quick access to the Kharid-et Dig Site; alternatively use the Archaeology journal and use the table at the Archaeology Guild to teleport to the Kharid-et Dig Site)
TokKul-Zo (if the quest The Elder Kiln has been completed for quick access to the TzHaar City)
Food (to survive the dangers of Freneskae)
Enhanced Excalibur (to survive the dangers of Freneskae)
Skeletal horror Teleport, earth altar teleport to the earth altar, invitation box, or Fort Forinthry lodestone (for quick access to the Paterdomus)
Memory strands (for quickest access to the Hall of Memories)

Ring of respawn (or a Passage of the abyss with ring of respawn charges for quick access to the White Knights' Castle), or a skills necklace to teleport south of Falador then take the shortcut just north-west to the castle or walk through Falador's south entry
Face mask, masked earmuffs, or Slayer helmet to avoid taking damage from inhaling the volcanic ash when travelling on Freneskae

rewards.t: The knowledge to restore the pontifex observation ring
The ability to gain Elder Troves from the Elder God Wars Dungeon

steps.t: Go up the stairs in Burthorpe Castle. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk to Azzanadra at the north-west corner. [Chat: Accept]

sub.t: Before continuing, make sure Azzanadra asks you to meet at Kharid-et Dig Site. Use the quest log if needed.

steps.t: Travel to Kharid-et Dig Site (use dig sites map or other means) and enter the main fortress. Talk to Azzanadra at the Praetorium war table (not in the Praetorium).
Travel to the World Gate and talk to Azzanadra. Teleporting, logging out or going to lobby will require starting this part over from this step.

sub.t: Use the Sixth-Age circuit to teleport, or run south from the Eagles' Peak lodestone, or teleport to the Outpost with a traveller's necklace and run west.

steps.t: Equip a face mask or masked earmuffs to protect against volcanic ash. Having a slayer helmet on the slayer helmet stand counts for this.
Enter the World Gate, travelling to the 'Approach' destination (first option). Make sure to finish the dialogue with Azzanadra upon entry.
Head east over the ledges, then up the cliffside.
Continue east, climbing down the drop, then talk to Azzanadra to the south-east. [Chat: 4 Let's just keep going]
Continue north, crossing the stepping stones and up the cliffside.
Continue north, wall run the overhang and talk to Azzanadra again. [Chat: 4 Let's just keep going]
Climb the cliffside, continue west and slide down the slope and head west.

sub.t: You can heal up by standing under the archway with the glowing crystals.

steps.t: Continue south, wrapping around east and north, then climb the nearby cliffside which is south of the archway.
Walk across the rock formation and talk to Azzanadra again. [Chat: 4 Let's just keep going]
Continue east and climb down the drop, then traverse the rock bridge to the east.
Talk to Azzanadra again.
Enter the opening.
Talk to Azzanadra.
Inspect the fragmented sphere at each end of the halls.
Talk to Ariane back at the centre, she gives you a blank observation. Azzanadra will replace this if you lost yours.
Collect memories from the elder god memory wisps (50 each).
Inspect the blank observation in your backpack.
Talk to Azzanadra.
Light voice and Shadow voice will speak to you. [Chat: 5 I've heard enough. I have a world to save.]
Travel to White Knights' Castle in Falador and enter the courtyard. Talk to Sir Upticious near the entrance.
Go up the eastern ladder then up the staircase by Sir Renitee to the altar in the castle. Talk to Father Frith. [Chat: Any]
Go to the floor 1, walk one room west from the ladder and talk to Sir Owen. [Chat: Any]
Return upstairs and talk to Father Frith.
Talk to Sir Amik Varze on the floor 3 in the west wing of the castle. [Chat: 1 Ask about 'Azzanadra's Quest'. › Any]
Talk to Padomenes in the courtyard. [Chat: 1 Ask about Azzanadra's Quest. › Any]
Talk to Sir Vyvin, found next to Sir Owen, located in the room south of Father Frith on floor 3. [Chat: 1 [Ask about Azzanadra's Quest.]]
Talk to Sir Owen on the floor 1, in the room west of the ladder.
Search the nearby drawers. [Chat: 1 Look for ritual documents.]
Go up the ladder into Sir Renitee's room and crack open the safe.
Right-click the slayer bell and use the 'Cut clapper' option to create a silent bell.
Travel to the Paterdomus and enter the Mausoleum to the north.

sub.t: Use the Skeletal horror Teleport or invitation box to get there quickly.

steps.t: Use the bell on the well to create a silent bell (blessed).
Return to Saradomin's throne in the White Knights' Castle by the altar and next to Father Frith on floor 3.
Ring the bell three times, calling Saradomin's name each time. [Chat: 1 Saradomin!]
Speak to Saradomin. [Chat: 3 The world is in danger. › Any › 2 We need to find the eggs. › 1 We need your crown.]
Travel to Kharid-et and talk to Azzanadra at the Praetorium war table. [Chat: ~]
Travel to the Hall of Memories (use the Sixth-Age circuit or memory strands to teleport to Memorial to Guthix)
Enter the pool. [Chat: 1 Yes. › Any › Any]
Capture the 6 Archivist's memories, then talk to the Archivist [Chat: Any › Any].
Capture the 6 restricted memories.
Interact with each of the plinths in the north-west and north-east.
Search the memory bud in the centre to receive a restricted engram.
Leave the Hall of Memories and use the restricted engram on the fountain of energy.

Travel to the entrance of the TzHaar City (use the TokKul-Zo to teleport to the main plaza then run south and exit the volcano). You can use the boss portal or the combat portal attuned to TzHaar Fight Cave to get there.

sub.t: Alternatively, fairy ring BLP is located near the fight cave. From here, leave the city through the exit to the south.

steps.t: Talk to Trindine on the surface of Karamja Volcano.
Enter the city, talk to Ga'al just north of the entrance. [Chat: Any]
Go north to the main plaza (you can teleport back here using the TokKul-Zo), talk to Trindine.
Talk to TokHaar-Hok.
Travel to the TzHaar City library (north-west of the main plaza), go inside.
Talk to Trindine.
Travel to the Wizards' Tower (use the wicked hood, stardust, or traveller's necklace to teleport)
Talk to Wizard Trindy on the floor 1 at the entrance of the Wizards' Tower. [Chat: Any]
Search four bookcases to the west.
Talk to Wizard Trindy at the eastern bookcases.
Return to Kharid-et Dig Site's praetorium war table.
Talk to Azzanadra.
Travel to the entrance of the Heart of Gielinor.

sub.t: Use The Heart teleport and leave by the wooden lift.
See other fast travel options if not using The Heart teleport.

steps.t: Talk to Azzanadra.
Enter the Heart [Chat: 1 Yes.] and continue the dialogue.
Observe each of the eggs at the end of the corridors.
Talk to Ariane.
Return to Kharid-et and enter to the main fortress. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Walk to the praetorium war table (you need to walk into the room where the table is to start the dialogue).
Stand next to any four shadow anchors around Kharid-et (see the map).
Harvest Trindine wisps until you get 50 memories.
Inspect the blank observation and finish the dialogue or Ga'al will not spawn for the next step.
Return to the TzHaar City main plaza.
Talk to Ga'al in the main plaza.
Return to the Wizards' Tower.
Walk to the entrance to trigger the dialogue.
Return to the Hall of Memories and enter the pool. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk to the Archivist.
Return to the Heart of Gielinor (enter from the entrance). [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk to Ariane. A cutscene will follow. [Chat: Any]
Talk to Ariane again.
Return to the White Knights' Castle, talk to Ariane on the bridge.
A cutscene will follow. [Chat: Any]
Return to Kharid-et, talk to Azzanadra at the praetorium war table to complete the quest.

sub.t: You need 3 free backpack spaces upon quest completion for the experience lamps rewarded.
